title: The Cybertruck Problem: 250,000 Promised, This Is What Sold (2026)
description:
Tesla planned to build two hundred fifty thousand Cybertrucks a year. In the best quarter of twenty twenty-six, the best estimate says it sold about eight thousand. That is thirteen percent of the plan, and the real number may be lower. The most famous truck in America has a numbers problem, and some of the numbers are stranger than you think. Here are seven of them, with the sources.
